name: 7 dnej leta: Nuar
source:
One shall get the reality he deserves.

A nameless executive has got a new contract: to investigate a mysterious anomaly near the small town of Radchenko. Nothing special, child's play — just do what you have been trained and everything will be fine. But from the very arrival some strange things begin to happen with him. And more than that — in a pub he meets a strange girl named Inga.
translation:
每个人都会得到自己应得的现实。

一名无名的特派员接到新的委托，前往拉德琴科小镇附近调查一处神秘的异常现象。没什么特别的，不过是小事一桩——只要照着受过的训练去做，一切都会顺利。然而，他刚到当地，怪事就接连发生。更有甚者，他还在酒馆遇见了一名叫英加的奇怪女子。
